caller_policy: New collision-free interfaces; preserve every historical caller. Copies earn zero new runner credit.

runners.name: ghc_family_cif_category_cardinality.py
runners.purpose: Validate a flat CIF loop's rectangular cardinality, case-insensitive data names, required columns, and declared row ceiling without padding absent cells.

runners.name: ghc_family_symmetry_code_literal_boundary.py
runners.purpose: Resolve only declared symmetry-code identifiers and preserve their three shift digits and expression as literals; never evaluate an expression or infer structure identity.

runners.name: ghc_family_reflection_merge_provenance.py
runners.purpose: Calculate explicitly weighted synthetic reflection groups while preserving all source members, literal Miller indices, and rejection reasons; no symmetry merging or statistical inference.

runners.name: ghc_family_detector_distance_uncertainty.py
runners.purpose: Carry a declared absolute interval bound for synthetic detector distance, convert its endpoints exactly, and refuse zero-crossing geometry and undeclared uncertainty interpretations.

runners.name: ghc_family_cell_setting_nonidentity.py
runners.purpose: Check a declared forward/reverse integer cell-setting pair as exact inverses, without inferring specimen identity or scientific equivalence.

runners.name: ghc_family_diffraction_image_fixity.py
runners.purpose: Verify an ordered synthetic image-byte capsule from declared chunks, exact length, and SHA-256; reject reordering, gaps, and over-budget reconstruction without handling a real image.

runners.name: ghc_family_reciprocal_basis_orientation.py
runners.purpose: Compute exact determinant, handedness, and dual-basis coefficients for a supplied finite rational basis while refusing singular geometry and empirical promotion.

runners.name: ghc_family_cif_loop_order_separation.py
runners.purpose: Compare keyed synthetic CIF rows under an explicit ordered or keyed relation; preserve duplicate-key ambiguity and distinguish cell changes from serialization order.

runners.name: ghc_family_structure_factor_missingness.py
runners.purpose: Parse bounded CIF numeric tokens with standard-uncertainty digits while preserving absent, unknown, inapplicable, and quoted literal states; never invent a measured structure factor.

runners.name: ghc_family_deposition_rollback_readback.py
runners.purpose: Preview an append-only rollback event only for a verified ancestor snapshot with matching current readback and retention; classify missing evidence and real release authority separately.
